Chapter 1120: 37: Lin Yuan And King Lingshen (Subscription Requested)_2

Chapter 1120: Chapter 37: Lin Yuan and King Lingshen (Subscription Requested)_2

But these Great Venerates, none of them could block the power of their own palm world.

“Could it be Hongye has broken through?”

King Lingshen gazed at his half-clenched right hand.

At this moment, not only could he not completely clench his right hand, but even the control over the world within his palm became hazy, unable to determine what exactly was happening inside.

Among all the Great Venerates in Qingfen Domain, Hongye Great Venerate undoubtedly had the highest potential, pursuing two paths of chaotic evolution with great hope of stepping into Heavenly Venerate.

…

In the world within his palm.

Great Venerate Hongye, Fire Axe Great Venerate, and numerous other Great Venerates were astonished at the scene before them.

The collapse of the five heavenly pillars just now, the collapse of the heavens and earth from four directions in time and space, had left all the Great Venerates in despair.

Yet at this moment, Lin Yuan suddenly emerged, raising his hand to block the imminent complete destruction of the world, even forcefully halting the falling five pillars, leaving them in a state of half-collapse.

“Galaxy Great Venerate? He actually possesses such power?”

“I can sense that the destructive force of the surrounding world is enough to easily obliterate a peak Great Venerate, yet Galaxy Great Venerate blocked it?”

“Galaxy Great Venerate didn’t just block it; he isolated the collapsing world.”

The various Great Venerates found it unbelievable.

Blocking the destructive force of a collapsing world and isolating the collapsing force are entirely different matters.

For instance, in a rapidly flowing river, blocking the impact of the flow and isolating that section of water presents entirely different challenges.

“Galaxy…” Great Venerate Hongye watched Lin Yuan’s single-handed effort to isolate the collapsing world, his heart understandably shaken.

“To what extent has my disciple grown?” Lord Qingfen was not much calmer; compared to other Great Venerates, he knew many of Lin Yuan’s ‘secrets’, such as his core royal status.

Yet even for a core royal member, to withstand the collapse of the surrounding world, at least reaching the level of King Chijue was necessary.

And how long had Lin Yuan been a Great Venerate?

Indeed, after Lin Yuan had defeated Thunder Spear Great Honored earlier, demonstrating nearly peak Great Venerate strength, Lord Qingfen deduced Lin Yuan had stepped into Great Venerate.

However, even for a core royal, stepping into Great Venerate required time to grow. But Lin Yuan?

“Everyone, when I break open this world later, you’d better get as far away as possible.” Lin Yuan glanced at the other Great Venerates around him.

In fact, even if King Lingshen didn’t make a move against him, Lin Yuan didn’t plan to stand by idly and watch the downfall of Qingfen Domain.

After all, Lord Qingfen had treated him well.

Previously, Lin Yuan needed to comprehend the war machine and perfect the fusion of the universe within him, devouring the Fierce Sun source. Despite not reaching peak strength yet, even taking action couldn’t affect the battle’s outcome.

It might even lead to him being targeted, affecting his cultivation and enlightenment.

Thus, he kept a low profile as much as possible.

But now? With the universe within and the Fierce Sun source completely fused, Lin Yuan’s strength had significantly advanced.

Even when facing Heavenly Venerate, he could retreat unscathed, and in this Fang Yuan World, as long as he didn’t act recklessly and provoke the founders of ancient countries, he could live without fear.

“Get far away?”

The Great Venerates exchanged glances and immediately nodded.

“Galaxy Great Venerate, rest assured, once you break this world, we will definitely run far away.”

“Indeed, even if we can’t help you, Galaxy, we certainly won’t hold you back.”

“If any of us haven’t escaped far by then, Galaxy Great Venerate, don’t worry about us. If we’re affected, so be it.”

The Great Venerates, with sharp insight, assessed Lin Yuan’s ability to easily block the collapse of the surrounding world and judged his strength far exceeded expectations.

Even if not as powerful as King Lingshen, he was on par with someone like King Chijue.

They were clearly not suited to participate in such battles among beings of this level.

“Hmm.”

Lin Yuan nodded.

With his strength, breaking open the surrounding world was naturally simple.

But he feared the other Great Venerates wouldn’t react fast enough, so he spoke up in advance.

“Open!”

Lin Yuan looked up at the five nearly fallen pillars, a terrifying aura centering on him spreading in all directions.

…

In a higher dimension.

King Chijue, who was being suppressed, looked at King Lingshen and sensed something amiss.

Because at this moment, King Lingshen’s right hand wasn’t fully clenched, his expression was fluctuating.

“An unforeseen variable has appeared.”

Before King Chijue could continue pondering, he saw King Lingshen, standing there motionless, his half-clenched right hand’s five fingers involuntarily spreading open.

Swish, swish, swish.

Time and space shattered widely.

Dozens of figures fled together, without hesitation, traversing the void in all directions.

At the same time.

Lin Yuan’s figure stopped not far away.

“Is that you?”

King Lingshen stared at Lin Yuan. At the moment when the world within his palm was broken, he saw the source that prevented him from tightly gripping his right hand—

The Great Lord of the Galaxy who once did him a favor.

“Galaxy?”

King Chijue was somewhat shocked too.

He did not know what had happened within the world in King Lingshen’s palm.

But ultimately all the Great Venerables escaped, and immediately distanced themselves from the battlefield, only Lin Yuan didn’t leave, clearly all this was related to the Great Lord of the Galaxy.

“King Lingshen.”

Lin Yuan looked at King Lingshen and said with a smile.

…

“He… The Galaxy…”

At the rear of the battlefield, King Red Pine also had a look of surprise, the escaped Great Venerables immediately informed him of everything that had happened in the world within King Lingshen’s palm.

“Good, good, good.”

King Red Pine experienced initial confusion, then a look of delight appeared on his face.

The Great Lord of the Galaxy suddenly displayed strength no weaker than King Chijue, directly reversing the tide of war.

Under these circumstances, the Great Venerables survived, and as long as they could safely retreat to Qingfen City, relying on the city’s protective formation, they had hopes of turning the situation around before the capital’s reinforcements arrived.

For King Red Pine who was already prepared for the failure of the war, this was an unexpected joy.

…

Rumble.

Lin Yuan forcibly broke King Lingshen’s world within his palm, causing a flaw to appear in the aura of this core royal who had grown to the peak.

King Chijue, who was being suppressed by King Lingshen, seized the opportunity to struggle with full force and finally broke free from the restraint.

“Great Lord of the Galaxy, it’s thanks to you this time.”

King Chijue appeared not far away and said to Lin Yuan with a slight gratitude.

By now, he too understood what had transpired, knowing it was all because of Lin Yuan.

Without Lin Yuan’s eruption, all the Great Venerables might have perished, and King Lingshen might have already reached Qingfen City.

“No matter.”

Lin Yuan said casually.

The distant King Lingshen, despite standing still, managed to exert slight pressure on him, which piqued Lin Yuan’s interest a bit.

“I would ask the Great Lord of the Galaxy to join me in holding King Lingshen back.”

King Chijue quickly conveyed his thoughts, having recognized Lin Yuan, considering this Great Lord of the Galaxy as a power of the same level as himself.

Facing the core royal King Lingshen who had grown to his limits, King Chijue did not have confidence to resist him alone, but if he could join forces with another power of the same level?

Even if they couldn’t win, they could secure a chance to retreat in one piece.

“No need to join forces.”

Looking at King Lingshen, whose aura became increasingly terrifying, Lin Yuan suddenly stepped forward, “I’ll handle it myself.”

“You’ll handle it yourself?” King Chijue looked at Lin Yuan, somewhat unable to comprehend.

Handle it yourself?

Before King Chijue could continue speaking.

Lin Yuan had already made his move.

A supremely intense force field instantly swept across a range of millions of miles, forming the Fierce Sun World naturally as a result of the operation of the Divine Body of Fierce Sun.

Below, Zi Meng and the nearby Great Venerables clearly felt the changes in the surrounding world. They could not perceive the scene in the higher spaces, nor would the Spirit Might King specifically inform them.

So they could only keep guessing in their minds.

“Fierce Sun Burning Heaven.”

It was Lin Yuan’s first time to fully operate the Divine Body of Fierce Sun. With the terrifying foundation of the inner universe supporting him, even with ordinary physique, he could unleash remarkable power, let alone with a killing physique like the Divine Body of Fierce Sun!

Crash.

The limitless Fierce Sun World operated, pressing down on King Lingshen.

“What?”

Whether it was King Chijue standing ready beside Lin Yuan, or King Red Pine watching from the rear of the battlefield, and even King Lingshen himself, felt a bit overwhelmed.

Rumble.

King Lingshen retreated four steps before finally stopping, having dissipated the suppression from the Fierce Sun World.

“I was actually injured?”

King Lingshen took a deep breath, looking at Lin Yuan as if facing a formidable enemy.
